# Astronomical 0.2.66
## Model library
- Removed the Laguna XS 2.1 entries (4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit) and the Laguna model family. - Removed the Qwen 3.8 MTP entries (27B oQ4e MTP 4-bit, 27B MTPLX Optimized Speed, 35B A3B Distill 4-bit); multi-token prediction machinery is fully retired from the engine. - Removed the DeepSeek V4 and Qwen 3.8 Flash model families.
## Reliability
- Changing the MLX memory ceiling while a model is resident now clears learned activation evidence, so stale evidence can no longer reject later requests; the largest expert layer is reserved exactly once during paged admission. - The dense engine streams validated model weights from disk.
## Serving
- Malformed or unknown model tool calls fail open to the harness instead of failing the request. - Enforced structured generation adopts the upstream grammar engine. - Qwen 3.5 reasoning honors a hard thinking budget. - Completion IDs carry a per-application namespace so tool-call IDs stay distinct across applications. - The status document reports serving activity and per-request progress; the Observatory console exposes local system telemetry and prompt-cache statistics.
## Compatibility and preserved user state
- Configuration files containing retired speculative-prefill fields are migrated automatically at load. - Installed models, prompt caches, and instance state are preserved; requests for removed model identities return a model-unavailable error listing near matches.
## Distribution
- Signed with a Developer ID identity under Hardened Runtime with secure timestamps, notarized by Apple, and distributed through the Sparkle-signed update feed.
